title: Optional AI deps, license inventory and scheduler
story: Optional AI provider dependencies and licenses; core scheduler
acceptance: package.json optionalDependencies contains exact-version (no ^ or ~) @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk and @google/genai, each published on or before 2026-10-04 (verified via npm view <pkg> time --json); dependencies stays empty and no other fields change
package-lock.json generated by npm install and consistent with package.json
node -e "import('@anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk')" succeeds, result noted in the ticket summary

docs/licenses.md lists the core (no runtime deps), every optional dependency and its transitive tree from npm ls --all --json with license field, flags any non-permissive license (or states none found), and explains optional-install behaviour

src/core/scheduler.mjs exports createScheduler or equivalent with every(ms, fn, {name}) returning a cancel function, timers unref'd, errors in fn caught and logged not thrown, stopAll() clears all; not wired into server.mjs
tests/unit/core/scheduler.test.mjs passes using short intervals or fake timers: runs repeatedly, error isolation, cancel, stopAll, unref
A platform-hub status is posted that the scheduler is available
brief: Pick versions: for each package run npm view <pkg> time --json and choose the latest version published on or before 2026-10-04 (two weeks before 2026-10-18); pin exactly in optionalDependencies. Edit package.json only in optionalDependencies. Run npm install (it is acceptable for the install to need the proxy; if the registry is unreachable, report it rather than hand-writing the lockfile). Verify the vertex-sdk import and note whether @google/genai imports too. For licenses, read each package's license field from npm ls --all --json plus node_modules/*/package.json; include a table: package, version, license, required/optional, notes. Flag anything not MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD/ISC; mention that the core itself has zero runtime dependencies and AI providers load lazily and optionally. Scheduler: src/core/scheduler.mjs, zero deps, ES module. every(ms, fn, {name}) uses setInterval with .unref(), wraps fn in try/catch (await async fns, skip overlapping runs of the same job), logs failures via an optional logger passed to createScheduler({log}) with console fallback, returns a cancel() function; stopAll() clears everything; expose list() of job names. Export a default createScheduler(opts) factory so server.mjs can later call stopAll on close. Do not edit server.mjs. After tests pass, post: AGENT_ID=ic-platform-runtime-dev node org/cli.mjs post platform status 'scheduler available at src/core/scheduler.mjs' --ticket S1-PLT-02.

verdicts.reason: All criteria verified: exact pins published 2026-09-30/10-02, lockfile present, imports work, licenses flag fast-sha256, scheduler unref/stopAll not wired, 6 tests pass
